detection_rules.name: manufactured metaphor or personification
detection_rules.name_zh: 刻意制造的比喻或拟人
detection_rules.note: An abstract construct is coupled to an unusually physical vehicle. Conventional disciplinary metaphors and negated figures are protected.
detection_rules.note_zh: 抽象概念被配上异常具体的物理意象；学科惯用语和被否定的比喻需要保护。

verification.note: All automatic marks reread; conventional technical noise/scaffold uses remain contextual protections.

detection_rules.name: aphoristic or punchline-style sentence

patterns.regex: ^(?:the old rules were gone|nothing else comes close|that changes everything|the rest follows)[.!]?$

detection_rules.note: A polished verdict may restate nearby content mainly for rhetorical force. One short sentence alone is not enough unless it matches a strong frame.
detection_rules.note_zh: 精致结论句可能只为制造力度而重复前文；普通短句本身不构成标记。

verification.note: Positive and negative regression fixtures pass; no context-bench occurrence.

detection_rules.name: artificial antithesis or slogan
detection_rules.note: Judge whether the opposition is false or compresses necessary qualifications. Ordinary rather-than distinctions are not marks.
detection_rules.note_zh: 阅读全文判断对立是否虚假或压缩了必要限定；普通 rather than 区分不标。

verification.note: Reading rule; pending full-text review.

detection_rules.name: false from-X-to-Y range
detection_rules.name_zh: 虚假的 from X to Y 范围
detection_rules.note: Review whether the endpoints form a real scale, sequence, or interval. Real temporal, numeric, and process ranges are protected. A `from` governed by a separation verb is excluded: `separate shared from unique contributions to X` is a complement, not a range.
detection_rules.note_zh: 检查两端是否构成真实尺度、顺序或区间；真实时间、数值和过程范围应保留。受分离类动词支配的 from 已排除：separate A from B to C 中的 from 是补语，不是范围起点。

verification.note: Revision 2 reread on the four testbed documents plus one unpublished draft not distributed with this repository, 18 hits. The separation-verb misfire is gone: `separate shared from unique contributions to the same three skills` no longer matches. Fourteen hits are functional ranges — temporal (`from the early 1950s to 2009`), numeric (`from age 6 to 49 years`), spatial (`from left to right`) and process (`from phonological decoding to whole word decoding`). Four remain the infinitival-join family recorded at revision 1 (`from an inability to perceive words`), where `to` heads an infinitive rather than a range terminus. Separating those needs part-of-speech information and is out of scope for a regex rule.

detection_rules.name: reader-directed evaluation
detection_rules.note: The prose announces that a point is clear, important, or the most informative instead of letting the evidence establish that ranking. Quantified or explicitly compared rankings are protected.
detection_rules.note_zh: 文本替读者宣布某点最清楚或最重要；有量化依据或明确比较集合的排序应保护。

verification.note: Both superlative constructions reread on A01; zero automatic marks on H01-H03.

detection_rules.name: mechanical navigation or metadiscourse

patterns.regex: \b(?:the next section (?:turns|moves) to|this brings us to|we now turn to|now let us (?:consider|examine)|before considering .{1,50}, it is useful to)\b
\b(?:it is important to note that|it should be noted that|the key point to remember is)\b

detection_rules.note: Mark complete navigation frames, never an isolated transition such as however or therefore.
detection_rules.note_zh: 只标完整的空转导航框架，绝不因单个 however 或 therefore 产生标记。

verification.note: Complete frames reread; isolated transition-word frequency remains removed.

detection_rules.name: rhetorical question or staged self-answer
detection_rules.name_zh: 修辞性设问或自问自答
detection_rules.note: A question may stage emphasis rather than define a real research question. Declared research questions, headings, FAQs, and quoted questions are protected.
detection_rules.note_zh: 问题可能只是制造强调；正式研究问题、标题、FAQ 和引文中的问题应保护。

verification.note: Protection is candidate-local except for explicitly enumerated research-question sequences; held-out AI-text verification is pending.

detection_rules.name: formulaic challenges-and-outlook closing
detection_rules.note: Check whether a closing section repeats generic challenges and optimism instead of ending on the last supported claim.
detection_rules.note_zh: 检查收尾是否用泛泛挑战与乐观展望替代最后一项有证据的结论。

verification.note: Reading rule; pending full-text review.

detection_rules.name: answering an objection no one raised
detection_rules.name_zh: 回答没人提出的反对意见
detection_rules.note: Check whether defensive framing answers an unattributed objection that the argument does not otherwise need.
detection_rules.note_zh: 检查防御性表述是否在回应一个没有来源、论证也不需要的反对意见。

verification.note: Reading rule; pending full-text review.

detection_rules.name: artificial alternative setup
detection_rules.name_zh: 先制造再否定虚假选项
detection_rules.note: Check whether the text invents an option no serious reader would choose, rejects it, and never uses it again.
detection_rules.note_zh: 检查文本是否制造一个无人会选的方案，随即否定，并再也不使用它。

verification.note: Reading rule; pending full-text review.

detection_rules.name: repeated negative-contrast frame
detection_rules.name_zh: 反复使用否定对照框架
detection_rules.note: Mark only repeated contrast frames within a paragraph. A single contrast is ordinary academic prose.
detection_rules.note_zh: 只标同段内反复出现的对照框架；单次对照属于普通学术表达。

verification.note: Repeated-frame candidates reread; single-frame triggers remain removed.

detection_rules.name: forced group of three
detection_rules.note: Mark only when an item is redundant, vague, or rhythm-filling. Genuine three-part entities, databases, measures, and author lists are protected.
detection_rules.note_zh: 只有某一项重复、空泛或明显补节奏时才标；真实三项对象、数据库、测量和作者名单应保护。

verification.note: Automatic triad detector removed after high-noise pilots.

detection_rules.name: uniform paragraph size
detection_rules.note: A document observation, not an AI score or an edit target. Report raw within-document facts only and never recommend splitting or merging paragraphs to move the statistic.
detection_rules.note_zh: 这是文档观察，不是 AI 分数或修改目标；只报告文档内部事实，绝不建议为改变统计量而拆并段落。

verification.note: The fixed word band is now executable configuration; held-out AI-text verification is pending.

detection_rules.name: promotional or inflated evaluation

patterns.regex: \b(?:particularly promising|advance(?:s|d)? the field|transformative contribution|major breakthrough|opens? (?:a )?new avenue|lasting contribution|reshape(?:s|d)? the field)\b

detection_rules.note: A complete promotional frame may be marked once; isolated watched words never produce a mark. This rule merges the former LEX-01, LEX-04, and OTHER-01 families.
detection_rules.note_zh: 完整推销框架可单独标记；孤立关注词绝不产生标记。本规则合并旧 LEX-01、LEX-04 和 OTHER-01。

verification.note: Paragraph-scope clustering now matches the declared scope; held-out AI-text verification is pending.

detection_rules.name: copula avoidance
detection_rules.note: Review whether a longer verb replaces a clearer is, are, or has. Technical meanings remain valid. Bare `function as` is excluded: in this field `executive function as` and `cognitive function as` are noun phrases, so only the unambiguous third-person `functions as` is matched. A plural subject with the bare verb is a known and accepted miss.
detection_rules.note_zh: 检查较长动词是否只是替代更清楚的 is、are 或 has；技术含义应保留。裸 function as 已排除：本领域 executive function / cognitive function 是名词短语，只匹配无歧义的第三人称 functions as。复数主语配裸动词是已知且接受的漏检。

verification.note: Revision 2 reread on the four testbed documents plus one unpublished draft not distributed with this repository. The A01 hit (`ERP features may serve as mechanistic intermediate phenotypes`) is a genuine ornate copula. The revision-1 misfire on `executive function as not being deficit-specific` is gone. Known and accepted miss: a plural subject with the bare verb, as in `these processes function as independent systems`.

detection_rules.name: shallow significance participle
detection_rules.name_zh: 用 -ing 尾巴制造虚假意义
detection_rules.note: Review whether the participial tail adds evidence or merely announces significance. Causal or procedural participles are not covered.
detection_rules.note_zh: 检查分词尾巴是否增加证据，还是只宣布意义；因果或程序性分词不在此列。

verification.note: All context-bench participial tails reread; contextual evidence addition remains decisive.

detection_rules.name: claim strength exceeds evidence
detection_rules.note: A strength cue asks for contextual review; it is not automatically excessive. Negation and task-manipulation uses are protected.
detection_rules.note_zh: 强度词只触发语境复查，并不自动构成过强论断；否定用法和任务操纵用法应保护。

verification.note: Directly negated claim cues are protected; task-manipulation and evidential fit still require contextual reading.

detection_rules.name: scope or causal overgeneralization
detection_rules.note: A scope cue asks whether the design supports the population, diagnosis, mechanism, or causal reach. Explicit conditions and bounded samples are protected.
detection_rules.note_zh: 范围词提示检查设计是否支持相应人群、诊断、机制或因果范围；明确条件和限定样本应保护。

verification.note: A01 conditional scope cue reread; contextual protection remains mandatory.

detection_rules.name: citation placement and stacking
detection_rules.note: Review where the citation sits relative to the claim it supports. Narrative form (`Kaiser et al. (2020) found ...`) when the study is the topic of the sentence; a trailing parenthetical only when the source merely backs a point. The second family catches an agentless attribution that hides who found what. This is a placement question, not an AI signal: on this project's context bench a 2021 human review stacked three or more sources at 3.67 per 1,000 words while the AI-assisted document did so zero times. Stacking is ordinary academic practice and a mark here asks only whether the reader can tell which source supports which claim.
detection_rules.note_zh: 检查引用相对于它支持的主张放在哪里。研究本身是句子主题时用叙述式（Kaiser et al. (2020) found ...）；来源只是佐证时才用句末括注。第二个家族抓无主语归属，它掩盖了是谁发现的。这是位置问题，不是 AI 信号：本项目对照台上，2021 年那篇真人综述每千词堆 3.67 处，AI 辅助文档是 0 处。堆叠是常规学术写法，这里的标记只问读者能否分清哪条来源支持哪个主张。

verification.note: All 42 hits reread. None is a parsing misfire: each is either three or more sources in one parenthetical or an agentless attribution carrying a citation. The distribution is the point — the AI-assisted document scores zero and the 2021 human review scores highest — so this rule marks a citation-placement question under the project's own editorial standard and is not evidence of anything about authorship. One H03 hit co-occurs with LOG-01, which is the co-occurrence signal working as intended.

detection_rules.name: invented paraphrase of a standard expression
detection_rules.name_zh: 自造说法替换标准表达
detection_rules.note: Does a phrase replace the field's conventional wording with an invented one? Judge the head collocation, not the whole n-gram: almost every four-word sequence of English is rare, and a control on prose nobody objected to returned the same rarity as the text under review. A coinage is a phrase whose standard alternative is in common use and whose own form is not, such as `explains least well` for `is weakest`. Technical terms of art are not coinages.
detection_rules.note_zh: 某个说法是不是把本领域的惯用表达换成了自造的？判断依据是核心搭配，不是整个 n-gram：几乎任何四词英文序列都是罕见的，对无人异议的文本做同样测量得到同样的罕见度。生造词指的是：它的标准替代说法很常见，而它自己的形式不常见，例如用 explains least well 代替 is weakest。专业术语不算生造。

verification.note: New reading rule; no automatic implementation exists.
